source_label: Araya Thai Lincoln's own menu (PDF, via arayathairestaurant.com)
pricing_notes: Dish prices list the options on the printed menu — e.g. '£14.50 / £15.50 / £15.95' = chicken or pork / beef / prawns.
Set menus are per person with a minimum of 2 people.

Starters.name: Chicken Satay (N)
Starters.description: Skewers of marinated chicken, barbecued and served with peanut sauce.

Starters.name: Thai Fish Cake (N)
Starters.description: Deep-fried Thai style spicy fish cake served with sweet chilli sauce and peanut.

Starters.name: Chicken & Prawn Toast
Starters.description: Chicken and prawn toast topped with sesame seeds served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Deep-Fried Prawns
Starters.description: Deep-fried prawns in crispy batter, served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Deep-Fried Squid
Starters.description: Deep-fried squid in a light batter, served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Duck Spring Rolls
Starters.description: Deep-fried spring rolls filled with aromatic shredded duck, leek, and carrot, wrapped in filo pastry and served with Thai-style red wine sauce.

Starters.name: Golden Parcels
Starters.description: Crispy filo pastry parcels filled with marinated minced chicken and prawns, served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Thai Dumpling
Starters.description: Thai style dumpling, marinated minced pork and prawn wrapped with wonton pastry, steamed and accompanied with Sriracha sauce.

Starters.name: Chicken Wing
Starters.description: Crispy chicken wing topped with tasty red wine sauce and sesame seeds.

Starters.name: Spare Ribs
Starters.description: Thai style marinated meaty spare ribs topped with tasty red wine sauce and sesame seeds.

Starters.name: Vegetable Spring Roll (V)
Starters.description: Deep-fried vegetable spring rolls served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Vegetable Tempura (V)
Starters.description: Deep-fried assorted vegetables in light batter served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Deep-Fried Tofu (V, N)
Starters.description: Deep-fried lightly battered fresh bean curd served with sweet chilli sauce and crushed peanut.

Starters.name: Vegetable Satay (V, N)
Starters.description: Skewers of assorted vegetables and bean curd grilled, served with peanut sauce.

Starters.name: New Zealand Mussels
Starters.description: Charcoal grilled New Zealand green mussels served with spicy fresh garlic and fresh chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Prawn Cracker
Starters.description: Thai spicy prawn cracker served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Classic Platter for 2 (N)
Starters.description: Extra £9.00 per additional person. A platter of favourite Thai starters including chicken satay, vegetable spring roll, chicken and prawn toast, Thai style spare rib, served with sweet chilli and peanut sauce.

Starters.name: Seafood Platter for 2
Starters.description: Extra £12.50 per additional person. A platter of assorted seafood including Thai fish cake, grilled giant king prawns, deep-fried prawns, grilled green mussel and grilled squid served with sweet chilli and Thai spicy garlic and chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Vegetarian Platter (V, N)
Starters.description: For 2 people, extra £8.00 per additional person. A platter of Thai vegetarian starters including spring roll, vegetable in batter and grilled vegetable skewers served with sweet chilli and peanut sauce.

Salads.name: Som Tum (Papaya Salad) (N)
Salads.description: A popular Thai spicy salad made with julienned green papaya, carrots, tomatoes, fresh chilli and garlic, flavoured with lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar and crushed peanuts.

Salads.name: Yum Nuea Yang (Beef Salad)
Salads.description: Grilled slices of tender beef seasoned with a spicy Thai dressing and tossed with fresh chilli, shallots, tomatoes and spring onions.

Salads.name: Larp Moo (Spicy Minced Pork)
Salads.description: A traditional north-eastern Thai dish of minced pork tossed with a spicy Thai dressing, dried chilli flakes, spring onions and fresh coriander.

Soups.name: Tom Yum Soup
Soups.description: Prawns or chicken. Thai flavoursome spicy, hot and sour soup with mushroom and tomatoes, flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chilli, lime juice and a little coconut milk.

Soups.name: Tom Yum Hed (V)
Soups.description: Thai flavoursome spicy, hot and sour soup with mushroom and tomatoes, flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chilli, lime juice and a little coconut milk.

Soups.name: Tom Kha Soup
Soups.description: Prawns or chicken. Light coconut milk soup, flavoured with mushroom, lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chilli and fresh coriander.

Soups.name: Tom Kha Hed (V)
Soups.description: Mushroom in light coconut milk soup, flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chilli and fresh coriander.

Curries.name: Gaeng Kiew Waan (Thai Green Curry)
Curries.description: An authentic Thai green curry cooked in coconut milk with aubergine, bamboo shoot, chilli, bell pepper and aromatic selection of Thai herbs. Your choice of chicken / pork, beef or prawns.

Curries.name: Gaeng Kiew Waan Jay (V)
Curries.description: Vegetarian green curry. An authentic Thai green curry cooked in coconut milk with tofu, chilli, vegetable and aromatic selection of Thai herbs.

Curries.name: Gaeng Daeng (Thai Red Curry)
Curries.description: An authentic Thai red curry cooked in coconut milk with aubergine, bamboo shoot, chilli, bell pepper and aromatic selection of Thai herbs. Your choice of chicken / pork, beef or prawns.

Curries.name: Gaeng Daeng Jay (V)
Curries.description: Vegetarian red curry. An authentic Thai red curry cooked in coconut milk with tofu, chilli, vegetable and aromatic selection of Thai herbs.

Curries.name: Massaman Curry (N)
Curries.description: A massaman curry paste with carrot, onion, potatoes, peanut and cashew nut slowly cooked in coconut milk, flavoured with cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and aromatic spices. Your choice of chicken / pork, beef or prawns.

Curries.name: Massaman Jay (V, N)
Curries.description: Vegetarian massaman curry. A Massaman curry with tofu, carrot, onion, potato, peanuts and cashew nuts, slowly simmered in creamy coconut milk with fragrant cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and aromatic spices.

Curries.name: Gaeng Garee (Thai Yellow Curry)
Curries.description: A mild and delicate flavour of yellow curry paste cooked in coconut milk with potatoes and onion, sprinkled with crispy shallot on top. Your choice of chicken / pork, beef or prawns.

Curries.name: Gaeng Garee Jay (V)
Curries.description: Vegetarian yellow curry. A mild and delicate flavour of yellow curry paste cooked in coconut milk with tofu, potatoes and onion, sprinkled with crispy shallot on top.

Curries.name: Gaeng Phed Ped Yang
Curries.description: Roast duck in red curry paste, well-cooked in coconut milk with pineapple, tomatoes and bell pepper.

Curries.name: Jungle Curry
Curries.description: A very hot and spicy curry without coconut milk, cooked with bamboo shoot, aubergine and fine bean, enhanced with wild ginger, young peppercorns and Thai herbs. Chicken / pork / tofu, beef or prawns.

Curries.name: Pa Nang Curry
Curries.description: A rich and creamy red curry cooked in coconut milk and flavoured with kaffir lime leaves. Your choice of chicken / pork, beef or prawns.

Curries.name: Vegetarian Panang Curry (V)
Curries.description: A rich and creamy red curry cooked in coconut milk with tofu and vegetables, flavoured with kaffir lime leaves.

Stir Fried.name: Pad Gra Poa
Stir Fried.description: A popular Thai stir-fried dish with fresh chilli, garlic, onion, fine bean, bamboo shoot and Thai basil leaves, with your choice of meat. Chicken / pork / tofu, beef or prawns.

Stir Fried.name: Ma Kue Sam Rot (V)
Stir Fried.description: Lightly battered aubergine with bell peppers, onions and Thai basil leaves, topped with a chilli and garlic sauce.

Stir Fried.name: Gai Pad Med Ma Muang (N)
Stir Fried.description: Stir-fried lightly battered chicken with cashew nuts, bell peppers, onions, chilli and spring onions.

Stir Fried.name: Pad Num Mun Hoy
Stir Fried.description: Stir-fried in oyster sauce with broccoli, carrots, onions, bell peppers and spring onions. Chicken / pork / tofu, beef or prawns.

Stir Fried.name: Pad Khing
Stir Fried.description: An aromatic stir-fried dish with fresh ginger, onions, mushrooms, spring onions and bell peppers. Chicken / pork / tofu, beef or prawns.

Stir Fried.name: Pad Priew Waan
Stir Fried.description: Stir-fried in a traditional Thai-style sweet and sour sauce with pineapple, tomatoes, onions and spring onions. Chicken / pork / tofu (vegetarian option available).

Stir Fried.name: Pad Prik Pao
Stir Fried.description: Stir-fried with fresh chilli, Thai chilli paste, onions, mushrooms, baby corn, bell peppers and Thai basil leaves. Chicken / pork / tofu, beef or prawns.

Chef Recommendation.name: Pineapple Fried Rice (N)
Chef Recommendation.description: Thai style fried rice with fresh pineapple, egg, onion, cashew nut, turmeric and yellow curry powder, served in a fresh-carved pineapple. Chicken / pork / tofu / beef / prawns.

Chef Recommendation.name: Gai Ma Kham (N)
Chef Recommendation.description: Lightly battered chicken in exotic tamarind and palm sugar sauce with pepper, onion, spring onion and cashew nut, garnished with crispy rice noodles.

Chef Recommendation.name: Ped Ma Kham
Chef Recommendation.description: Crispy marinated duck breast topped with exotic tamarind and palm sugar sauce, garnished with crispy shallot and crispy rice noodles.

Chef Recommendation.name: Ped Pad Nam Prik Pao
Chef Recommendation.description: Stir-fried marinated roast duck in Thai chilli oil with baby corn, mushroom, spring onion, pepper and basil leaves.

Chef Recommendation.name: Ped Priew Waan
Chef Recommendation.description: Crispy marinated duck topped with Thai style sweet and sour sauce, pineapple, tomatoes, onion, spring onion and bell pepper.

Chef Recommendation.name: Pra Ram Rong Song (N)
Chef Recommendation.description: Slow cooked marinated beef in creamy red curry paste, coconut milk and crushed peanut, served on a bed of white cabbage and topped with cashew nut.

Sizzling Platters.name: Neau Prik Tai Dum (Sizzling)
Sizzling Platters.description: Sizzling tender beef with black peppercorn sauce and ginger, mushroom, pepper, onion and spring onion.

Sizzling Platters.name: Goong Yai Pad Bai Gra Poa (Sizzling)
Sizzling Platters.description: Sizzling giant king prawns stir-fried with Thai basil leaves, fresh chilli, garlic, fine bean, onion and pepper, served on a hot sizzling platter.

Sizzling Platters.name: Goong Pao (Sizzling)
Sizzling Platters.description: Char-grilled giant king prawns served on onion, pepper and mushroom with Thai style spicy chilli and garlic dipping sauce.

Sizzling Platters.name: Choo Chee Goong Yai
Sizzling Platters.description: Pan-fried giant king prawn topped with rich and flavoursome red curry, cooked in coconut milk with kaffir lime leaves.

Sizzling Platters.name: Tom Yum Goong Yai
Sizzling Platters.description: Famous Thai spicy hot and sour soup with giant king prawn, mushroom and tomatoes, flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chilli, lime juice and a touch of coconut milk, served in a Thai style hot pot.

Sizzling Platters.name: Goong Ma Kham
Sizzling Platters.description: Lightly battered giant king prawns topped with exotic tamarind and palm sugar sauce with bell pepper, onion and crispy shallot, garnished with crispy rice noodles.

Sizzling Platters.name: Goong Yai Gra Tiem Prik Tai
Sizzling Platters.description: Succulent giant king prawns stir-fried with crushed garlic, white pepper and mixed peppers in a rich garlic and pepper sauce.

Sizzling Platters.name: Goong Pad Pong Garee
Sizzling Platters.description: An authentic Thai favourite of giant king prawns stir-fried in a rich yellow curry sauce with turmeric egg, fresh chilli, onion and spring onion.

Sea Bass.name: Sea Bass Neung Manow
Sea Bass.description: Steamed seabass fillet topped with lime juice, fresh chilli, fish sauce, crushed garlic with lemon slice and coriander.

Sea Bass.name: Sea Bass Lad Prik
Sea Bass.description: Lightly battered seabass fillet topped with rich and flavoursome sauce made from fresh chilli, garlic, onion, pepper and coriander root.

Sea Bass.name: Sea Bass Priew Waan
Sea Bass.description: Lightly battered sea bass fillet topped with Thai style sweet and sour sauce, pineapple, tomatoes, onion, spring onion and pepper.

Sea Bass.name: Sea Bass Pad Khing
Sea Bass.description: Lightly battered sea bass fillet topped with a mixture of soy sauce, oyster sauce, fresh ginger, mushroom, pepper, onion and spring onion.

Sea Bass.name: Sea Bass Choo Chee
Sea Bass.description: Pan-fried seabass fillet topped with a rich and flavoursome red curry, cooked in coconut milk and infused with fragrant kaffir lime leaves.

Rice & Noodles.name: Coconut Rice
Rice & Noodles.description: Steamed Thai jasmine rice with coconut milk.

Rice & Noodles.name: Plain Noodle
Rice & Noodles.description: Stir-fried egg noodle with egg, beansprout and spring onion.

Rice & Noodles.name: Pad Thai (N)
Rice & Noodles.description: The signature Thai stir-fried rice noodle with egg, bean sprout, spring onion and carrot in tamarind and palm sugar sauce, served with crushed peanut, dried chilli flakes and a wedge of lemon. Your choice of tofu, chicken / pork or prawns.

Rice & Noodles.name: Pad See Eiw
Rice & Noodles.description: A popular Thai noodle — flat rice noodles stir-fried with egg, broccoli, carrots and cabbage, in dark soya sauce and white pepper. Your choice of tofu, chicken / pork or prawns.

Desserts.name: Mango Sticky Rice
Desserts.description: Perfectly ripened fragrant mango served with sticky rice cooked with coconut milk. (Seasonal)

Desserts.name: Mango with Vanilla Ice Cream
Desserts.description: Perfectly ripened fragrant mango topped with golden syrup, accompanied by a scoop of vanilla ice cream and whipping cream. (Seasonal)

Desserts.name: Banana Fritter (N)
Desserts.description: Deep-fried banana in light batter topped with golden syrup, accompanied by a scoop of vanilla ice cream and whipping cream.

Desserts.name: Chocolate Banana (N)
Desserts.description: Three scoops of vanilla ice cream served with banana topped with chocolate sauce, crushed cashew nuts and whipping cream.

Desserts.name: Vanilla Summer (N)
Desserts.description: Three scoops of vanilla ice cream served with pineapple topped with golden syrup, crushed cashew nuts and whipping cream.

Desserts.name: Baileys Cream Vanilla (N)
Desserts.description: Three scoops of vanilla ice cream topped with Baileys Irish cream and crushed cashew nut.

Desserts.name: Tia Maria Vanilla (N)
Desserts.description: Three scoops of vanilla ice cream topped with Tia Maria liqueur and crushed cashew nut.

Desserts.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
Desserts.description: Three scoops of vanilla ice cream.

Set Menus.name: Set Menu A
Set Menus.description: Minimum 2 people, per person. Tom yum soup; mixed starter platter (chicken satay, spring roll, chicken and prawn toast, Thai style spare ribs with peanut sauce); Thai green curry; gai ma kham or goong ma kham; pad pak raum. Served with steamed Thai jasmine rice.

Set Menus.name: Set Menu B
Set Menus.description: Minimum 2 people, per person. Tom yum soup; mixed starter platter; massaman curry; goong yai prik tai dum or neau prik tai dum; pad pak raum. Served with steamed Thai jasmine rice.

Set Menus.name: Set Menu Vegetarian (V)
Set Menus.description: Minimum 2 people, per person. Tom yum soup; vegetarian mixed platter; Thai green curry; ma kue sam rot; pad pak raum. Served with steamed Thai jasmine rice.
